skill.summary: This skill should be used when writing test cases, fixing bugs, analyzing code for potential issues, or improving test coverage for JavaScript/TypeScript applications. Use this for unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, debugging runtime errors, logic bugs, performance issues, security vulnerabilities, and systematic code analysis.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of test-specialist: a comprehensive skill for testing, debugging, and code analysis in JavaScript/TypeScript applications.

- Provides structured methods for writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
- Details systematic approaches for bug detection, isolation, and resolution.
- Outlines ways to proactively identify common issues like security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, and logic errors.
- Includes guidelines and tools for analyzing and improving test coverage.
- Offers practical test patterns and code examples across key scenarios.
